data.claim: Splitting ddflow/api/rules.py into ddflow/api/rules/{dedup,write,add,mutate,read}.py (each <30k chars) plus __init__.py re-exporting every previously-public name leaves all import sites unchanged: `from ddflow.api.rules import ...`, `from ddflow.api import rules as R`, and `from ddflow.api import rule_*`.
data.falsifier: An existing import site raises ImportError/AttributeError after the split (e.g. R._cross_kind used by tests/test_coherence_coverage.py's inspect-based check).
data.mechanism: Rename rules.py to rules/__init__.py and move the functions one area per module; __init__ re-exports Rule, RuleDedupAnswer, RulesStorage, rules_manifest, apply_rule_update and every rule_* name so `from .rules import Rule` in ddflow/api/__init__.py and the test import sites resolve identically.

data.question: Can ddflow/api/rules.py be split into a package ddflow/api/rules/ with submodules each <30k chars that re-export the full public API with unchanged call sites and no behavior change?

evidence.note: Research R2cc4994671 CONFIRMED: renaming rules.py to rules/__init__.py moves functions one area per module and re-exports every public name; probe confirmed all import sites resolve (ddflow.api.rules import, ddflow.api import rules as R, private helpers R._cross_kind/R._check_edit used by test_coherence_coverage) with no ImportError/AttributeError.

Ran ddflow_brief at session start (project rules digest + lessons ranked to this task) and read the rules governing the split: r-small-files (submodule <30k), the import-linter layers contract (surfaces > api > views > services > infra > config > core: api may import services/infra/core below it, so rules/* importing ddflow.services/infra/core is in-layer-legal), and the kilo orchestration contract (ddflow_kilo_orchestration_contract_rewritten). ddflow/api/rules* globs kept the rename within the lease.

Committed 9a2e27bb6: ddflow/api/rules.py -> package ddflow/api/rules/{__init__,dedup,write,add,mutate,read}.py (delete + 6 files). Submodule sizes: __init__ 1546, add 7650, dedup 6156, mutate 5709, read 8408, write 10765 chars -- all <30k. ruff check + ruff format clean on ddflow/api/rules/. __init__ re-exports the full public API (Rule, RuleDedupAnswer, RulesStorage, DEFAULT_RULE_PRIORITY, rules_manifest, apply_rule_update, rule_add/update/remove/get/list/search/sync, rule_dedup_check, rule_dedup_check_dry_run) plus the private helpers tests introspect (R._cross_kind, R._check_edit, R._add_checked_against_others, R._answer_other_kind).
